ios.desc:
Streaks 66 Habit Tracker: Ultimate App for Building New Daily Habits

Transform your daily routine and build lasting habits with Streaks 66 Habit Tracker. Challenge yourself to a 66-day journey with customizable difficulty options, guided by our intelligent Habit Coach AI. Stay on track, motivated, and share your success with those who matter.

Key Features:

66-Day Challenge:
Commit to a new habit and track your progress over 66 days, the scientifically-backed period for habit formation.

Difficulty Modes:
Choose the level that suits you best—Perfect Mode for the disciplined, Normal Mode for the balanced, and Easy Mode for those just getting started.

Habit Coach AI:
Stay motivated and on track with our integrated AI Habit Coach. Get personalized advice, motivation, and insights about your habits and goals.

Reminders:
Set and receive timely reminders to ensure you never miss a day.

Share Your Habits:
Inspire and be inspired by sharing your habit streaks and results with friends and family.

iCloud Sync:
Seamlessly sync your data across all your devices.

In-App Purchase Options:
We offer two subscription models and a lifetime purchase option:
USD $1.99 per month: 
Provides premium access to our app for 1 month. The renewal price remains the same.
USD $19.99 per year: 
Provides premium access to our app for 1 year. The renewal price remains the same.
USD $49.99 for lifetime access: This one-time purchase grants lifetime premium access to our app.

Premium User Benefits:
Unlimited habits
Unlimited messages to the Habit Coach AI (terms apply)

Free User Benefits:
1 active habit
3 messages to the Habit Coach AI

For a detailed breakdown of our subscription options, including how to manage or cancel your subscription, please visit our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages:
https://sites.google.com/vincentpeng.me/streaks66/privacy-policy
https://sites.google.com/vincentpeng.me/streaks66/terms-conditions

Take the first step towards a better you with Streaks 66 Habit Tracker, designed to make habit-building simple, effective, and fun. Download now and start your journey to a new you!

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News,

I'm excited to share Streaks 66, an AI-powered habit tracker designed to help users build lasting habits. We recently launched on Product Hunt and received 100+ votes, and now we want to bring it to the Hacker News community.

Key Features:
- 66-day challenges with customizable difficulty levels
- Habit Coach AI for personalized advice and motivation
- Reminders to keep you on track
- Share your results
- sync with iCloud, no need to login to use

We're dedicated to making habit-building simple, effective, and fun. I'd love to hear your feedback and answer any questions.

Check out Streaks 66 here: 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/streaks-66-habit-tracker-ai/id6496863309

Thanks!
